entries.f90b89f2b0d3ff0b: As its basic management philosophy, it sets out aiming to be the best company in the financial services industry, thoroughly maintaining a neutral stance and fair thinking, and respecting the value of the individual while valuing the spirit of harmony. In its medium- to long-term strategy, it plans to focus management resources on the IR consulting services field of the Information Service Business, and to bring the acquisition of financial and economic data in-house and reallocate human resources. In the Advertising Agency Business, it plans to strengthen its capacity to respond to advertising and promotion methods using online channels, and in the Crypto-Asset and Blockchain Business, it plans to maintain a cautious trading policy.
